result.title: Embodied-VGGT: Preserving Reliable Local Geometry for Long-Sequence Reconstruction
result.summary: Long sequence reconstruction must correct accumulated drift while preserving locally consistent geometry. In robotics and autonomous driving, embodied acquisition provides recurring platform- environment geometry and repeated observations of scene structure and platform motion. We present Embodied-VGGT, which exploits these cues to establish reliable local relationships and selectively preserve them during global refinement. Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks (MAGC) builds on Scal3R's global context memory and uses relative scale references derived from predicted ground geometry to regularize test-time memory updates, encouraging cross-chunk consistency while limiting changes to reliable local geometry. Superpoint Alignment (SA) and Cross-Loop Optimization (CL) jointly address the robust establishment and preservation of geometric relationships. SA balances ground and non-ground evidence across spatial regions to estimate inter-chunk translation. CL uses geometric and motion consistency across interleaved windows to select coherent chunk groups, each receiving a shared Sim(3) correction that preserves its internal relative transformations during global optimization. Experiments on five public driving benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements in long sequence reconstruction. On KITTI Odometry, Embodied-VGGT achieves a mean absolute trajectory error of 7.30 m and a Chamfer distance of 2.67 m, reducing these errors by 46.8% and 23.3% compared with the state-of-the-art baseline under same evaluation protocol. To facilitate reproducibility, we released our code: https://github.com/Ang-Sheep/Embodied-VGGT.

AI.brief_summary: 面向长序列三维重建中的漂移累积问题，提出 Embodied-VGGT：利用地面几何导出的相对尺度约束在测试时更新全局记忆，并通过超点对齐与跨循环优化分组保持可靠的局部几何关系，在五个驾驶基准上降低轨迹与重建误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属几何重建而非 VLM 推理，但其「测试时记忆更新的可靠性约束」与「按一致性筛选证据并保留可信局部状态」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的更新、缓存与视觉证据筛选提供类比线索，需核查其约束构造是否可脱离几何假设。
